title: Energy Efficient Three Phase Squirrel Cage Induction Motors (Third Revision)

amendments.details: Updates on IE4 efficiency measurement tolerances
Clarifications on variable frequency drive (VFD) duty

certification_scheme: BIS ISI Mark Mandatory under QCO
qco_order_title: Electrical Motors (Quality Control) Order, Ministry of Heavy Industries
scope_summary: Covers efficiency classes (IE2, IE3, IE4) and performance specifications for line-operated 3-phase squirrel cage induction motors with rated voltage up to 1000V, 50Hz, power rating from 0.12 kW to 1000 kW for industrial and general applications.

technical_parameters.product: Three Phase Squirrel Cage Induction Motor
technical_parameters.mounting: Foot mounted / Flange mounted (as per IS 1231 / IS 2223)
technical_parameters.application: Industrial pumps, fans, compressors, conveyors, heavy machinery
technical_parameters.operating_environment: Standard industrial ambient up to 50°C, high humidity

compendium_source: BIS Compendium of Standards on Energy Efficient Industrial Machinery (ETD-15)

title: Rotating Electrical Machines - Part 1: Rating and Performance
scope_summary: Applies to all rotating electrical machines except those covered by other IEC standards. Establishes duty types (S1-S9), thermal classes, insulation limits, rating plates, temperature rise, and overload tolerances.

technical_parameters.product: Rotating Electrical Machines / AC & DC Motors

title: Three-Phase Induction Motors - Specification (Fifth Revision)
qco_order_title: Superseded by Bureau of Indian Standards Notification
scope_summary: Historical standard for medium and low voltage three-phase induction motors. Now fully superseded by energy-efficiency-mandated IS 12615.

title: Guide for Testing Three-Phase Induction Motors (First Revision)
certification_scheme: BIS Test Code for Compliance Verification
scope_summary: Prescribes methods of test for three-phase induction motors including insulation resistance measurement, no-load test, locked rotor test, temperature rise test by resistance method, efficiency determination by loss segregation, and high voltage dielectric withstand test.

title: Rotating Electrical Machines - Part 5: Degrees of Protection Provided by Integral Design of Rotating Electrical Machines (IP Code)
qco_order_title: Industrial Safety and Environmental Enclosure Regulation
scope_summary: Defines requirements for protective enclosures of rotating machines (IP codes like IP54, IP55, IP56, IP65, IP66). Specifies tests for protection of persons against contact with live or moving parts, ingress of solid foreign objects, and harmful ingress of water.

title: Code of Practice for Installation and Maintenance of Induction Motors (Second Revision)
certification_scheme: BIS Code of Practice (GFR Compliance Mandatory)
scope_summary: Provides comprehensive guidance on site selection, concrete foundation design, alignment with driven machines (direct flexible coupling, belt drives), electrical cable termination, earthing connection, commissioning pre-checks, and periodic preventive maintenance for induction motors.

technical_parameters.alignment_tolerance: Within 0.05 mm radial and axial runout
technical_parameters.earthing: Two independent earth connections as per IS 3043

title: Dimensions of Three-Phase Foot-Mounted Induction Motors (Third Revision)
scope_summary: Specifies standard frame sizes (frame numbers 56 to 450), shaft heights, shaft extension diameters, keyway dimensions, and fixing hole center distances for foot-mounted three-phase induction motors to ensure mechanical interchangeability.

title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement (Fourth Revision)

amendments.details: Introduction of earthquake-resistant D grade (Fe 500D, Fe 550D)
Addition of Fe 650 and Fe 700 high strength grades

certification_scheme: BIS ISI Mark Mandatory under QCO
qco_order_title: Steel and Steel Products (Quality Control) Order, Ministry of Steel
scope_summary: Specifies chemical composition, physical properties, tensile yield strength, elongation, bend, rebend, and rib geometry for thermo-mechanically treated (TMT) deformed steel bars (Fe 415, Fe 500, Fe 500D, Fe 550D) used in RCC construction.

technical_parameters.application: Reinforced concrete buildings, bridges, dams, transport infrastructure

title: Metallic Materials - Tensile Testing: Part 1 Method of Test at Room Temperature (Fifth Revision)
scope_summary: Prescribes method of tensile testing for metallic materials and determines proof strength, upper and lower yield strength, tensile ultimate strength, percentage elongation after fracture, and percentage reduction of area.

title: Ordinary Portland Cement - Specification (Sixth Revision)

amendments.details: Packaging in HDPE / paper bags norms

certification_scheme: BIS ISI Mark Mandatory under QCO
scope_summary: Unified standard covering 33 grade, 43 grade, and 53 grade Ordinary Portland Cement (OPC). Specifies chemical requirements (insoluble residue, magnesia, loss on ignition) and physical requirements (fineness, setting time, sound, and compressive strength at 3, 7, and 28 days).

technical_parameters.application: High-rise structures, precast concrete, pavements, RCC bridges

title: Plain and Reinforced Concrete - Code of Practice (Fourth Revision)

amendments.details: Exposure conditions and cover to reinforcement
Mineral admixtures (fly ash, GGBS, silica fume)

certification_scheme: National Building Code / GFR Mandatory Code
qco_order_title: Central & State PWD Technical Specification Mandatory Code
scope_summary: General structural engineering code for concrete structures. Details materials, workability, durability requirements, minimum cementitious content, water-cement ratios, structural design limit states (flexure, compression, shear, torsion), and workmanship.

technical_parameters.slump_range: 25 mm to 150 mm depending on placement method

title: Polyvinyl Chloride Insulated Cables for Working Voltages up to and Including 1100 V (Fourth Revision)
certification_scheme: BIS ISI Mark Mandatory under QCO
qco_order_title: Electrical Wires, Cables and Appliances QCO, DPIIT
scope_summary: Requirements for single core, multi-core circular and flat PVC insulated copper or aluminium conductor cables for electric power and lighting up to 1100V AC. Includes FRLS and zero-halogen fire safety cable types.

technical_parameters.insulation: PVC Type A, Type C (HR), FR, FRLS
technical_parameters.application: Internal building electrification, switchboards, lighting circuits

title: PVC Insulated (Heavy Duty) Electric Cables: Part 1 for Working Voltages up to and Including 1100 V (Third Revision)

amendments.details: Armouring round wire and strip tolerances

certification_scheme: BIS ISI Mark Mandatory under QCO
qco_order_title: Cables and Conductors Quality Control Order
scope_summary: Requirements for armoured and unarmoured heavy duty PVC insulated power and control cables for power distribution up to 1100V.

technical_parameters.armour: Galvanized round steel wire / formed steel strip

title: Code of Practice for Earthing (Second Revision)
certification_scheme: Statutory Electrical Safety Code (Central Electricity Authority CEA)
qco_order_title: CEA Safety Regulations & CPWD Electrical Specs
scope_summary: Authoritative Indian code for electrical grounding and earthing of LV, MV, and HV installations, sub-stations, industrial equipment, generators, motors, and consumer premises.

technical_parameters.earth_resistance: <= 1.0 Ohm for sub-stations, <= 5.0 Ohm for industrial machinery

title: Luminaires Performance - Part 2 Particular Requirements - Section 2 LED Street Light Luminaires
qco_order_title: Electronics and Information Technology Goods (Requirement for Compulsory Registration) Order, MeitY
scope_summary: Specifies performance, electrical, photometrical, and thermal requirements for LED luminaires for road and street lighting, including luminous efficacy, power factor, total harmonic distortion (THD), colour temperature (CCT), CRI, and surge immunity.

technical_parameters.surge_protection: >= 4 kV (standard), >= 10 kV (high risk road lightning zones)
technical_parameters.ingress_protection: IP66 minimum for optical and control gear compartments

title: Luminaires: Part 5 Particular Requirements: Section 3 Luminaires for Road and Street Lighting

amendments.details: Thermal endurance and mechanical vibration tests

certification_scheme: BIS ISI / CRS Mandatory Safety Standard
scope_summary: Specifies mandatory safety and structural requirements for road and street lighting luminaires, including electric shock protection, creepage and clearance distances, thermal endurance, and resistance to dust and moisture.

title: High Density Polyethylene (HDPE) Pipes for Water Supply - Specification (Fifth Revision)
certification_scheme: BIS ISI Mark Mandatory under QCO
qco_order_title: Pipes and Fittings Quality Control Order, Department of Chemicals & Petrochemicals
scope_summary: Requirements for high density polyethylene (HDPE) pipes made from PE 63, PE 80, and PE 100 raw materials for buried and above-ground conveyance of potable water under pressure (PN 2.5 to PN 16).

title: Centrifugally Cast (Ductile) Iron Pressure Pipes for Water, Gas and Sewage - Specification (Third Revision)
certification_scheme: BIS ISI Mark Mandatory under QCO
qco_order_title: Ductile Iron Pipes QCO, Ministry of Steel
scope_summary: Specifies manufacturing, hydrostatic pressure testing, cement mortar lining, and external zinc coating for ductile iron pipes (Class K7, K9, K12) with socket and spigot push-on joints for water and sewage mains.

title: Crystalline Silicon Terrestrial Photovoltaic (PV) Modules - Design Qualification and Type Approval
qco_order_title: Solar Photovoltaics, Systems, Devices and Components Goods (Requirements for Compulsory Registration) Order, MNRE
scope_summary: Prescribes requirements for design qualification and type approval of terrestrial crystalline silicon photovoltaic modules suitable for long-term outdoor operation in general open-air climates.
